rounds.title: Round 1
rounds.prompt: Name a reason an FRC robot fails its initial inspection at competition.

answers.text: Over the 125 lb weight limit
Bumpers out of zone or corner gaps
Sharp edges or exposed pinch points
Main breaker inaccessible or unmarked
Pneumatic system leak or over-pressure
Illegal wire gauge or reversed polarity

rounds.title: Round 2
rounds.prompt: Name a rule violation that will earn your alliance an immediate Yellow or Red Card.

answers.text: Entering field before green lights / field safe
Damaging contact inside opponent frame perimeter
Pinning opponent >3 seconds after referee countdown
Deliberately tipping or flipping another robot
Egregious conduct or referee disrespect (G201)

rounds.title: Round 3
rounds.prompt: Name an item or tool every team is frantically trying to borrow in the pits.

answers.text: Zip ties or electrical / gaffer tape
Freshly charged 12V robot battery
7/16" or 10mm wrench / socket
1/4-20 bolts, nuts, or hardware
Hex keys / Allen wrench set
Rivet gun or pop rivets

rounds.title: Round 4
rounds.prompt: Name something the drive team must check or do right before the match starts.

answers.text: Turn on main 120A robot breaker
Plug in driver station joysticks / controllers
Connect field Ethernet tether / check FMS link
Pre-load the game piece properly
Align robot on starting line / auto orientation

rounds.title: Round 5
rounds.prompt: Name an excuse a drive team gives when their robot suddenly stops moving on the field.

answers.text: Radio rebooted or lost wireless FMS link
Battery brownout / voltage drop under load
CAN bus wire snapped or disconnected
Code crashed / RoboRIO watchdog loop error
Main breaker tripped or wire pulled out

rounds.title: Round 6
rounds.prompt: Name something a robot attempts to do during the 15-second Autonomous period.

answers.text: Score a pre-loaded game piece
Leave starting zone / Mobility taxi points
Intake a center-field game piece
Disrupt or block opposing alliance paths
Sit dead / do nothing (Auto routine failed)

rounds.title: Round 7
rounds.prompt: Name a part of the robot that must strictly follow Game Manual construction rules.

answers.text: Bumpers (Height zone, backing, pool noodles)
Frame Perimeter / Starting sizing envelope
Maximum extension outside frame perimeter
Robot battery mounting and tie-down strap
Pneumatic storage tanks & pressure relief valve

rounds.title: Round 8
rounds.prompt: Name something team scouts track while watching a match from the stands.

answers.text: Number of game pieces scored / cycle times
Autonomous success and starting position
Endgame climb / hang level achieved
Fouls and penalties committed
Defensive capability and robot reliability

rounds.title: Round 9
rounds.prompt: Name a safety violation that will get you scolded by the Safety Advisor in the pits.

answers.text: Not wearing safety glasses
Wearing open-toed shoes / sandals
Running or horseplay in the pit aisles
Using power tools without proper PPE
Working on an enabled or pressurized robot

rounds.title: Round 10
rounds.prompt: Name something an FRC Human Player is responsible for during a match.

answers.text: Feeding / introducing game pieces into play
Throwing / tossing game pieces into scoring targets
Triggering endgame activation or substation buttons
Communicating field info / timer to drive team
Staying behind the starting line / boundary

rounds.title: Round 11
rounds.prompt: Name a reason an FRC match gets delayed right before starting.

answers.text: Robot cannot connect to the field FMS
Alliance called a timeout coupon
Field element repair or broken sensor
Robot battery / bumper falling off on field
Broken game piece or debris left on carpet

rounds.title: Round 12
rounds.prompt: Name a trait an Alliance Captain looks for when picking a playoff partner.

answers.text: High game piece scoring rate / cycle consistency
Reliable and fast endgame climb / hang
Solid autonomous routine that does not conflict
Heavy defense and counter-defense capability
No robot breakdowns / clean electrical wiring

rounds.title: Round 13
rounds.prompt: Name an official FRC award that teams compete fiercely for at competitions.

answers.text: FIRST Impact Award (Chairman's)
Engineering Inspiration Award
Industrial Design Award / Quality Award
Rookie All-Star Award
Autonomous Award / Innovation in Control

rounds.title: Round 14
rounds.prompt: Name a common material or part used to build an FRC robot.

answers.text: Aluminum tubing / plates
Polycarbonate / Lexan sheets
3D-printed parts (PLA, PETG, Onyx)
Pool noodles (for bumpers)
Falcon, Kraken, or NEO brushless motors
